topThree.title: 他们当时的嘲讽声好大啊
topThree.observed: Pinned cover combines old newspaper/robot imagery, with a headline about prior ridicule and reversal tags.
topThree.inferredNarrative: Prior skepticism contrasted with later progress; emotional reversal.
topThree.suggestedAdaptationNotObservedCuts: Show a verified earlier limitation, then cut to a corresponding current achievement. Keep dates and capability boundaries visible.

topThree.title: 藏在人形机器人里的核心零部件
topThree.observed: Pinned cover places a robot among circular component callouts; core components words highlighted in yellow. Description promises three components.
topThree.inferredNarrative: Reveal the unseen technical parts behind a visible robot capability.
topThree.suggestedAdaptationNotObservedCuts: Begin with an action, show the relevant component close-up, then use one short animated causal explanation and return to the action.

topThree.title: 没人会等你20年，但日本机器人会！
topThree.observed: Title uses a long time interval, a conversational setup, and reversal hashtags.
topThree.inferredNarrative: Use a memorable time comparison and conversational contrast to invite interest.
topThree.suggestedAdaptationNotObservedCuts: Use dated, equivalent-condition clips in a before/after comparison, keep explanations short, and avoid equating edited demonstrations with matched tests.
